gita-a00-v01.speaker: Abhinavagupta (mangala colophon)
gita-a00-v01.question: Who triumphs, and what is he the treasury of?
premises: He who, made of the widely flashing wheel of diverse states, comes to be the objects of experience.
Whose one is given to contemplation, thus the bond of nondifference: Śaṃbhura, woe-averting, triumphs — treasury of the lights of knowing.
gita-a00-v01.inference: The mangala invokes the knowing-treasury: the bhāva-cakra's nondifference-bond names what the work stores — bodha-bhāsās.

gita-a00-v02.speaker: Abhinavagupta (mangala colophon)
gita-a00-v02.question: Why is the Gītā held supreme among expositions?
premises: By the sage Dvaipāyana this scripture was expounded, measured by hundreds of thousands; here liberation is established as the fruit.
Other dharma-and-rest of it is recited to nourish that fruit [mādhānyataḥ: LIVE fork, grounds in L0].
gita-a00-v02.inference: The Gītārthasaṃgraha claims prāmāṇya through Vyāsa-lineage, sahasraśata-measure, and mokṣa-as-phala; the forked ablative's sense-slot stays open (honest gap).
uncertainties: 5 LIVE L0 forks in this unit-set (see L0 grounds): yadekamayabhāvanāvaśata, etyabhedānvayaṃ, śaṃbhuraśivāpaho, mādhānyataḥ (prime), iyānprathiḥ — print corrupt per Ingalls; Gita Supersite + Sharma 1983 pending

option_choices.reason: Honest gap: mādhānyataḥ unattested; neutral surface held (no gloss invented) pending Gita Supersite collation + Sharma 1983 emendations — comparative/source-emends recorded as rejected alternatives, not chosen.

gita-a00-v03.speaker: Abhinavagupta (mangala colophon)
gita-a00-v03.question: What is liberation named as?
premises: Liberation by name is complete-differentiation in form, all-knowing, auspicious-natured, free from need, in Bhagavān the Lord, ever-risen.
Dissolution — this much [prathiḥ: LIVE fork] — in summary.
gita-a00-v03.inference: Mokṣa is defined by compound-nature (saṃskāra-svabhāva, sarvajña, nityodita) and reduced to laya in samāsa — the forked 'this-much-toward-it' held open.

gita-a00-v04.speaker: Abhinavagupta (mangala colophon)
gita-a00-v04.question: How does the Gītā compare to other mokṣa-celebrations?
premises: Although liberation by name is celebrated in other connections, yet the Bhagavadgītā is the giver of true attainment.
gita-a00-v04.inference: Other texts sing mokṣa incidentally; the Gītā gives samyak-prāpti — the supremacy claim is exclusive (samyak retained).

gita-a00-v05.speaker: Abhinavagupta (mangala colophon)
gita-a00-v05.question: Why write another exposition?
premises: Earlier ones made many expositions among them, yet this attempt is reasonable — revealing its hidden meaning.
gita-a00-v05.inference: The udyama is justified by gūḍhārtha-prakāśana: prior vyākhyās are many, this one discloses the hidden sense (bhāṣya not prakaraṇa).

gita-a00-v06.speaker: Abhinavagupta (mangala colophon)
gita-a00-v06.question: What is this work's colophon?
premises: From Bhaṭṭa Indurāja's oral tradition, examined long with thought, made by Abhinavagupta — this here is the Gītārthasaṃgraha.
gita-a00-v06.inference: The verse seals authorship: āmnāya from Bhaṭṭa Indurāja (his Pratyabhijñā teacher), long vivicana, kṛta by Abhinavagupta — the name declared.

essence: The bhāva-cakra's nondifference-bond names the work's treasury: lights of knowing, triumphed by woe-averting Śaṃbhura.
Vyāsa-lineage, hundreds-of-thousands measure, mokṣa-as-fruit: the Gītārthasaṃgraha's prāmāṇya is claimed here [one LIVE fork, grounds in L0].
Liberation named: complete-differentiation-form, all-knowing, need-free, ever-risen in Bhagavān — laya, this much, in summary [one LIVE fork].
Other texts sing mokṣa incidentally; the Bhagavadgītā gives true attainment.
Many earlier expositions; this attempt reasonable — revealing the hidden meaning.
Bhaṭṭa Indurāja's tradition, long-examined, made by Abhinavagupta: the name declared.

rasa.dominant: adbhuta-śānta of the treasury opened (wonder at the work's own store)
rasa.justification: The verses wonder their own contents — what is stored, by what authority, named how — then settle into signature; relish is self-declaration, not argument.

sections.SUMMARY: The bhāva-cakra's nondifference-bond names the work's treasury: lights of knowing, triumphed by woe-averting Śaṃbhura. Vyāsa-lineage, hundreds-of-thousands measure, mokṣa-as-fruit: the Gītārthasaṃgraha's prāmāṇya is claimed here [one LIVE fork, grounds in L0]. Liberation named: complete-differentiation-form, all-knowing, need-free, ever-risen in Bhagavān — laya, this much, in summary [one LIVE fork]. Other texts sing mokṣa incidentally; the Bhagavadgītā gives true attainment. Many earlier expositions; this attempt reasonable — revealing the hidden meaning. Bhaṭṭa Indurāja's tradition, long-examined, made by Abhinavagupta: the name declared.
sections.FUNCTION: Opens the work with a six-verse mangala: invocation, prāmāṇya-claim, mokṣa-definition, Gītā-supremacy, exculpation-of-effort, and the signed colophon.
sections.KEY TERMS: bhāva-cakra (diverse-state wheel as the text's own image); bodha-bhāsā (lights of knowing); prāmāṇya (authority claim); saṃskāra-svabhāva (complete-differentiation form); gūḍhārtha-prakāśaka (hidden-meaning revealer); āmnāya (oral tradition from Bhaṭṭendurāja).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: The six benedictory verses precede adhyāya 1; they set the work's voice (colophon-as-verse) and its authority-claim before any Gītā commentary begins.
sections.BOUNDARY: Five L0 forks held open (mādhānyataḥ prime) — honest gaps pending Supersite/Sharma collation; no emendation smuggled into the song.
sections.EXPLANATION: The mangala works in six moves: what the work stores (knowing-lights), why it may speak (Vyāsa-lineage + measure + fruit), what mokṣa is (compounds → laya), why this text above others (samyak-prāpti), why another effort at all (gūḍhārtha), and who made it (āmnāya + name). The corrupted-print tokens stay forked — the claims they carry (authority, summary, treasury) do not depend on resolving them.
sections.RELATED: Sharma 1983 (English translation, emendations) + Gita Supersite (IIT Kanpur) as future collation/witness; Ingalls preface on print corruption; qa NEEDS_WITNESS until Sharma quoted.

Rejected: 'despite many' — kept although (yadyapi concessive); 'obscure' for gūḍha — kept hidden (it is there, veiled).

reads_against.argmap: Why write another exposition? → The udyama is justified by gūḍhārtha-prakāśana: prior vyākhyās are many, this one discloses the hidden sense (bhāṣya not prakaraṇa).
c1_essence: Many earlier expositions; this attempt reasonable — revealing the hidden meaning.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta-śānta of the treasury opened (wonder at the work's own store)

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: the signed colophon — āmnāya + vivicana + kṛta + name (the verse performs authorship). Sanskrit-first: bhaṭṭendurājāt āmnāya kept the lineage-source; ciraṃ dhiyā kept long-with-thought; kṛto 'bhinavaguptena kept passive signature; so 'yaṃ kept this-here (deictic seal). Rows: 9 (tradition/thought/maker chain), 1 ('the Gītārthasaṃgraha' closes — the NAME lands last, the verse's whole purpose). Close: 'the Gītārthasaṃgraha.' Rejected: 'Abhinavagupta composed this' reorder — killed: passive signature is the printed shape (maker-last, name-last); 'understood' for vivicya — kept examined.

reads_against.argmap: What is this work's colophon? → The verse seals authorship: āmnāya from Bhaṭṭa Indurāja (his Pratyabhijñā teacher), long vivicana, kṛta by Abhinavagupta — the name declared.
c1_essence: Bhaṭṭa Indurāja's tradition, long-examined, made by Abhinavagupta: the name declared.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta-śānta of the treasury opened (wonder at the work's own store)
